summary: Explain payload availability and make usage detail lookup reliable

delivery.outcome: Make usage details truthful and reliable for archived and metadata-only calls, with explicit unlinked/unavailable states and race-safe asynchronous selection.
nonGoals: No guessed joins of historical prompts to journal rows, provider-policy changes, token-budget changes, private payload ingestion into public telemetry, or unreviewed runtime promotion.

architecture.decision: Keep archive IDs separate from numeric journal IDs. Report additive payload_capture metadata; fetch every valid selected ID, distinguish absent linkage from storage failure and ignore stale detail responses. Preserve loopback/same-origin access and payload-free telemetry.
interfaceChanges: Add payload_capture state to detail responses and surface typed archive-unavailable failures.

evidence: Private offline DOM regression and local read-only HTTP fixture.

architecture.rollback: Revert the material ticket-152 changes; no schema migration or historical archive rewrite.

validation.evidence: Private host receipts subllm-usage-audit-20261027; protected exact-head CI and independent publication.
